title: Kalshi says the CFTC has ordered it to halt trading on "mention markets" tied to what President Trump will say during public events (Bobby Allyn/Bloomberg)
summary: Bobby Allyn / Bloomberg: Kalshi says the CFTC has ordered it to halt trading on “mention markets” tied to what President Trump will say during public events — Federal regulators ordered Kalshi Inc. to halt trading on markets tied to what President Donald Trump will say during public events …
